name: Temuco
summary: Official municipal sources establish Temuco's local Catastro/DOM custodian and an anonymous parcel-role geocoder in the municipal IDE. The accessible routes did not yield a safe parcel ID plus full polygon response; no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Spanish first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-2926-temuco.json. They found the official Municipalidad de Temuco interactive parcel/address page, municipal transparency evidence for Departamento de Catastro, and the official IDE Temuco ArcGIS REST directory and parcel GeocodeServer.
requestOutcomes: The official REST root, ESTUDIOS folder and parcel GeocodeServer metadata returned HTTP 200. The CATASTRO folder returned ArcGIS error 499 Token Required. A bounded anonymous geocoder request returned zero candidates, but it was not a polygon query. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup or TLS-disable action was used.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official REST root listed CATASTRO and ESTUDIOS folders.
JSON error 499 Token Required; no authenticated retry.
Parcel-role geocoder metadata returned, including WKID 32718; no polygon layer or safe ID-plus-geometry response.
Empty candidate response; not evidence of parcel absence.
Official page loaded but exposed only a placeholder, not viewer configuration.
